programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shannon, 24, says two years ago, her ex-boyfriend stabbed her multiple times, and she feels betrayed by her mother, Dian, because she didn’t visit her in the hospital. Can they make peace with the past and fix their relationship? Plus, Kasey says she wants her 24-year-old son to stop living at home and playing video games all the time -- but is she part of the problem?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.desc: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

programme.desc: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: A state ranger (Roy Rogers) clears a crusading judge framed for a bank robbery.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy's horse-breeding plans are complicated by a gambler in this fictional account of Trigger's conception and birth.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: A singing ranch foreman and his sidekick convince a young British nobleman to keep, rather than sell, the ranch left to him by his late father.

programme.title: Arizona Bound

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A baby in a hurry has Bill concerned the mother will be delivering in the back of his ambulance. To add to the pressure, this is a high-risk pregnancy. A guest of honour has collapsed in front of her family at a milestone birthday celebration. Nhi and Carlos arrive at the crowded party as four generations of worried relatives look on. Aaron and Laura rush to an amputee in agony. The man tripped over after grabbing a burger and managed to dial for help with his nose!

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Australia’s Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Emma West faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, but he’s putting up a fight. Drs Jonathan Papson and Mya Cubitt race to save the life of a young man whose car slammed into a pole. Dr Mark Putland treats a factory worker who’s in shock after being confronted with his horrific life-changing injuries. A heavily pregnant young woman presents a challenge for Dr Michelle Thornhill.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A gunshot victim arrives at The Royal Melbourne Hospital under police guard. Dr Sarah Whitelaw fears the patient could die from his injuries, but the shooter is still at large, posing a risk. Dr Jonathan Papson treats a football player who could bleed to death from kidney damage, after an on-field collision. Dr Michael Dunne and nurse Lucy Stranger assess a pregnant car crash patient who can’t feel her baby move. Dr Michelle races to the waiting room after a woman mysteriously collapses.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Fiona Nicholson uses her reassuring bedside manner on a young man with a racing heart and spiking blood pressure - but she’ll have to stop his heart beating in order to save him. A patient with a gruesome head wound has Dr Sarah Whitelaw on full alert, and unseen internal injuries could make things even worse. Nurse Julia Hoiles helps a smitten young couple who spend their first date in emergency. Dr Michael Dunne treats a nurse-to-be who has smashed her leg in a car accident.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Every moment counts, as the unconscious patient has severe blood loss. Dr Lauren Cohen treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff. 20-year-veteran Dr Tom Razga treats the ‘walking wounded’ in triage, reassuring a highly anxious woman who has a small wound. Is Dr Michelle Thornhill’s patient constipated from pasta or is it more serious?

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Miriam Yassa is on high alert for the baby’s welfare, and the cause of the mum-to-be’s collapse. Dr Sarah Whitelaw treats a cyclist after a car hit him from behind. He can’t remember the accident or feel his feet. Support volunteer Jean is on hand for comfort and cups of tea and is a welcome distraction for stressed patients.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst moments. A rider is bucked off her horse and is lying helpless in remote bushland. The only way out is a risky chopper rescue but there is nowhere to land. Ben and his new paramedic partner, Mim rush to a young Mum who’s smashed her elbow at a kid’s roller-skating party and Bill tries to save a teacher having a massive heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to emergencies of all kinds. Laura and Aaron prepare for double the complications as a mum with a high-risk pregnancy goes into labour. In a first for the show, cameras follow the patient into hospital not to save a life, but to welcome a new one. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst for a motorcyclist with life-threatening injuries after a horror crash. Sam and Chris race to a teen who’s had a seizure at home and whacked her head on the tiled floor.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: South Australia’s first responders spring into action when calls for help come in. Ben and Mim find a grandfather in agony with horrific burns after spilling a huge pot of boiling water over himself. Lisa’s first day back from maternity leave has her examining a tiny baby with a soaring heart rate and high temperature. Sam and Chris treat a teen’s gruesome injuries after he attempted to jump a spiked fence. Bill treats a retired nurse who’s in agony from tripping while bringing in the bins.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every few minutes a call for help comes through to South Australia’s paramedics. Aaron and Laura fear the worst as they rush to a teen victim of a frightening shark bite. Sam and Chris worry a woman’s next breath might be her last as she fights a chronic lung condition. Ben and Mim must tackle a footy player who’s dislocated his shoulder and super mums, Sally and Olivia race to a terrified one year old who’s crashed through a glass coffee table.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as paramedics rush to help people in crisis. A leaking oxygen bottle blows up in a man’s face, resulting in severe facial and airway burns. Nhi and Carlos fear he could stop breathing at any moment. A violent knife fight has Bill on high alert. Laura and Aaron work extra hard to win a young boy’s trust, after a family holiday ends in disaster. And a toddler struggles to breathe after a dangerous allergic reaction.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as paramedics help everyday people in crisis. Aaron and Laura rush to a heart-breaking emergency. A young mother with advanced cervical cancer has collapsed in front of her family and is bleeding heavily. A bizarre case for Lisa as she finds a hard-core chilli lover in excruciating pain. Bill races to help a brave Vietnam war veteran who is gasping for breath and Carlos and Nhi are on high alert for a man with sudden chest pains.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every minute a call for help arrives at the South Australian Ambulance Service from people in crisis. Ben and Mim prepare for the worst as they rush to a high-impact two car collision. Later, the pair are called to a patient in the last stages of labour. Newly qualified Ben has never delivered a baby and he’s hoping this will be his first. A dementia case hits home for Lisa who lost her beloved grandmother to the insidious disease.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A hero bystander uses CPR to bring a woman back from the dead but intensive care paramedic Bill needs to get the grandmother to hospital before she goes back into a fatal cardiac arrest. Alarm bells ring for Sally and Olivia as they examine a churchgoer who’s whacked her head on a pew. A logistical nightmare for Laura and Aaron as they try to find an injured mountain biker in a national park and Dan meets a feisty 89-year-old who’s determined to reach her milestone birthday.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as calls for help arrive at the South Australian Ambulance Service. Paramedics, Sally and Olivia fear the worst for a young motorcyclist in agonising pain after a terrifying accident. Bill knows time is critical as he races to a man who’s collapsed and is now unconscious and Laura and Aaron are impressed by the courage of a little boy who has suffered an horrific fractured leg after crashing off his pushbike.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a volatile man who’s been on a two-day drug bender, putting himself and staff at risk. Dr Jonathan’s patient has a shocking fracture after falling four metres from a ladder. Dr Luke examines a man who has collapsed at home and suffered deep facial bruising, but what caused the fall? Dr Emma calls in reinforcements to save a mum whose life hangs in the balance after a high-speed crash on a country road.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A grandfather of nine has a broken leg and massive blood loss after a motorbike accident, but his vital signs aren’t showing Dr Jana Alexander and Dr Jonathan Papson the danger he’s in. A teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. However, the potentially career-ending injury is not Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing jewellery from swollen fingers, which isn’t something he learned in medical school.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Royal Melbourne Emergency, a young abattoir worker is in agony after amputating her fingers. Dr Bjorn Makein and Nurse Sarah Thomas must stop the bleeding if there’s any chance of saving the woman’s hand. Dr Emma West’s patient has major head injuries after falling down stairs on her way to a wedding. Dr Michelle Thornhill treats a cyclist who’s come off his bike while not wearing a helmet. Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A crane operator crushed under falling steel at work is rushed to Royal Melbourne Emergency. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats a pregnant woman who is semi-conscious and behaving erratically. Dr Michelle Thornhill reassures a man who has impaled a drill bit through his hand. But how will she get it out? Dr Scott Taylor recommends an electric shock to reset a father-of-two’s dangerously fast heartbeat.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, a pregnant woman survives a car accident. Now, Dr Emma West must stop the terrified mum going into premature labour. Dr Sarah Whitelaw and the team battle to save a teen driver who’s rolled his car, is unresponsive, and has serious head injuries. Dr Scott Taylor fears a diabetic man might need an amputation. A trail bike rider has crashed face-first. Despite his injuries, he impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his resilience and wit.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In Royal Melbourne Emergency, Drs Emma and Jonathan battle to save a father of two from bleeding to death after he’s thrown from a horse. Where’s he bleeding from? Dr Luke looks for the cause of a law student’s puzzling condition which has terrified her worried parents. Dr Michelle’s young patient is in agony from broken bones after a motorbike accident and doesn’t want his parents to know. Dr George has grave fears for a handy-man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete while helping a mate.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Heart stopping moments at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe after multiple heart attacks. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from his backyard hive. Everything changes in a moment as he races to attend a stabbing victim who has no pulse. Nurse Sarah searches for the baby’s heartbeat after a pregnant woman is injured in a car crash.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Every second counts at Royal Melbourne Emergency as injured people keep arriving. Dr Luke treats a tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks! Dr Jonathan is concerned for a uni student who’s fallen six metres from the famous Hanging Rock. Dr Michelle treats a young motorcyclist with broken wrists who’s kept his bike a secret from his parents. Dr Martin helps a mum of two with a painful burn injury caused by boiling pasta.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock fighting to save lives. A do-it-yourself loving handyman gets himself into trouble when he tumbles off a three-metre ladder. With no memory, the brave patient may have a brain bleed. Steve and Emily are ready for anything as an office worker is hot and dizzy, and down to his undies. Babysitting duties turn into a nightmare for a terrified grandmother. Eamon is unimpressed with Mike’s fashion sense, and a former grave digger laughs in the face of death.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Exclusive cameras capture the extraordinary work of emergency service heroes. Steve races to remote bushland where a huge tree has fallen and crushed a man’s leg. Cullen takes drastic action to save a patient whose body is shutting down. Cam and Al bend the rules to lift the spirits of a nine-year-old boy after a frightening asthma attack. Homesick Emily ‘adopts’ a Nanna for the day, when she and Steve help a much-loved grandmother and a terrified daughter watches her Mum fight for life.

programme.title: OK! MADAM!
programme.desc: Mi-Young runs a shop at a traditional market where she makes and sells twisted bread sticks. Her husband Seok-Hwan works as a computer repairman. One day Seok-Hwan wins a free trip to Hawaii. Mi-Young and Seok-Hwan will go on their first international trip together. programme.title: The Night Shift
programme.desc: “Something strange is happening here at Gwanglim mansion.” Ji-woo a webtoon artist visits a small and deserted mansion located outside of Seoul to gather an idea for his work. But while he is searching the area he listens to suspicious stories from the manager. A stray pair of shoes which are far off from the corridor a giggling sound of laughter from invisible children… Despite of spooky atmosphere which sneaks in Ji-woo he unconsciously goes deeper into that strange mansion.

programme.title: The Point Men
programme.desc: When Korean tourists are taken hostage by the Taliban in Afghanistan, a skilled diplomat and a special agent must work together in a desperate race to save the remaining hostages.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Detente A Pitufar Rosas
programme.desc: La malvada hechicera Clorhidris quiere borrar todo el amor y la belleza de la faz de la tierra. programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado Acechador, que captura animales silvestres para venderlos, tiene a Abuelo Pitufo y a Pitufo Salvaje de los nervios. Nana Pitufa y Smoogle acuden al rescate, capturando al Acechador en una de sus propias trampas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tras malinterpretar algo que oye, Pitufo Reportero publica que Gargamel desea ser amigo de los Pitufos. Gargamel secuestra a los Pitufos, y Pitufo Reportero es ahora el responsable de escribir la historia de su rescate.

programme.title: Niñeras Chapuseras
programme.desc: Mientras Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo y Pitufo Goloso discuten, Hogata secuestra a Bebé Pitufo para preparar una fórmula para tener la piel suave como la de un bebé. programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel despide a Escrupuloso, que se va a vivir con Gigantón. Mientras los Pitufitos ayudan a Gigantón a organizar una fiesta, Escrupuloso los captura para congraciarse con Gargamel. Pero no cuenta con que Gigantón acudirá al rescate.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por pura casualidad, un elefante que pasaba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, y los Pitufos deciden crear un gran Circo. Van a visitar al hechicero infernal Baltazar y Bebé Pitufo se lo está pasando genial…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Deslizándose por un arcoíris, un caballito alado pierde una herradura dorada. Tras encontrarse con Pitufina, ambos van en su búsqueda. Al final, acaban encariñándose ya que quién podría resistirse al encanto de un caballito alado…o de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: El Primer Telepitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo vierte una poción mágica sobre el nuevo sembrado de melones, que crecen instantáneamente e inundan la aldea y el bosque. programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. programme.title: El Buen Vecino De Pitufo

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick rolls into to this central pa town and visits the historic Campus Theater where he satisfies one of his life long quests. Then he checks out a restaurant that has mastered the art of the smashburger! He'll witness the making of some of the best snowboards in the world, then close out this road trip by hitting Mecum's Auto Auction where the Caddy awaits him after its new restoration.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early morning fishing trip followed by a rustic riverside breakfast. It’s a brief but colorful pause before the journey continues deeper into isolation.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. With no cameras allowed beyond a certain point, Jeff experiences a rare glimpse into a community untouched by modern influence—where ancient ways of life endure in harmony with the forest. It is a quiet, humbling encounter that marks the emotional peak of the Amazon journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale of It’s a Beautiful World, Jeff looks back on the unforgettable meals and spontaneous encounters and places that shaped his journey through the Amazon. This episode captures the emotional heart of the expedition.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This gem in the beautiful Mountain State is known for its connection to John Brown's raid. Hop in the seat and ride along as Nick travels back in time to a candy store that uses centuries old recipes and chows down at a restaurant specializing in vegan delights. Then take a walk on the Appalachian Trail with an AT Legend!
